"
Cochranella
"
xanthocheridia
is a species of
frog
in the family
Centrolenidae
. It has an uncertain generic placement (
incertae sedis
) within
subfamily
Centroleninae
;
[
2
]
[
3
]
molecular data are not available and morphological and behavioural characters do not unambiguously
place it in any specific genus.
[
3
]
Cochranella xanthocheridia
is
endemic
to Colombia
[
2
]
and known from the
Cordillera Occidental
in the
Córdoba
,
Antioquia
, and
Risaralda Departments
at elevations of 480–2,060 m (1,570–6,760 ft)
asl
.
[
4
]
The species' natural
habitats
are tropical rain forests of the Andean foothills and montane forests.
[
4
]
It is threatened by
habitat loss
caused by
agricultural expansion
and timber extraction, and by water pollution.

1
